trigger: replica system clock skewed against the database by hours, then a fleet usage read
classification_rationale: the fresh/stale split compared a replica-clock instant with usage_state.last_seen authored by the database clock; reporting_devices, stale_devices and the fresh flags were wrong with no signal to the caller
summary: Freshness mixed two clocks. Fixed (adapted by the Architect: carry the width, not an instant): DexUsageQuery::fresh_since_epoch is now fresh_secs and the one statement compares us.last_seen >= now() - $10::bigint * interval '1 second' on the database clock; the observation window stays on the request instant. Pinned by a [pg] owner case at DB now()-47h, -50h and a device with no usage_state row under skews of 0, +-36 h and +-49 h, and a seam assert that a skewed injected instant leaves the width unchanged.

policy_floor: Resource Ledger and ledger fragment must be committed
trigger: governance.d fragment and Resource Ledger left empty or untracked at push
classification_rationale: a required evidence artefact (the populated ledger fragment) was missing; it contradicts nothing
summary: The .jsonl was empty and both governance.d files were untracked. Fixed: the .jsonl is populated from the Gate 7 table with this adjudication's dispositions and the resource ledger lines the fix round made stale are refreshed. The orchestrator commits both files with the fix round (the engineer never commits).

trigger: slice=group with group=%00, an invalid UTF-8 byte or a 257-byte id
classification_rationale: a group id that cannot name a group was classified as a retryable 503 after an audit row and an Apps read, where the sibling perf route returns a 400
summary: Group id was checked by size only. Fixed (adapted): the route now refuses it before the audit and the read with the shared mgmt_group_id_ok predicate (1..256 bytes, no C0 control or NUL or DEL, valid UTF-8), which already covers what app_perf_param_valid plus is_valid_utf8 would and is already included in the route file, so no third copy and no new include. A 400, no audit row, no read.

trigger: hostile group id (CWE-117) never exercised through the route
classification_rationale: no test pinned the validate-before-audit order for a hostile group id
summary: Fixed: extra requests inside the existing 400s route case (NUL, embedded NUL, newline, DEL, 0xFF, overlong 0xC0 0x80, truncated sequence, 257 bytes) each give 400 with zero dex.apps.usage.view rows and no usage read.

trigger: a management group deleted between get_group_checked and get_members_checked
classification_rationale: the docs promise never a 200 with everyone in the residual cell, but the race produced one, cached 30 s
summary: Fixed (adapted: a reorder with no extra read): the group_members closure reads get_members_checked first and get_group_checked second, so a group deleted in between is unknown_group (400, never cached). The harness closure mirrors the order and tests/test_dex_apps_wiring_lexical.py pins it with a self-test mutation.

trigger: an ambiguous_name application row in a 200
classification_rationale: the route's own rule says a withheld figure is JSON null, never 0, yet an ambiguous row serialised devices: 0
summary: Fixed (adapted: null, not a reword): devices is null for ambiguous_name; no_usage keeps 0 and below_floor keeps the real count. Serializer, the usage_model test, the DexAppsUsage schema (nullable, with a completeness pin) and the docs updated.

trigger: fleet at or beyond about 150,000 online devices, or an operator following the 'add an index' remediation
classification_rationale: the code comment, REST remediation, runbook and alert text named an executable-key index as the fix; the reviewer's measurement found the planner ignored it
summary: Fixed: the index remedy and the 'has not been measured' sentence are removed from the owner comment, the fleet_too_large remediation string, docs/dex/app-usage.md, the rest-api reference and the alert description. The measurement is stated with its scope (synthetic dataset of about 205 usage rows per device, one test host, 4.1 s at 60,000 devices, the 10 s bound near 150,000 by extrapolation, not a guaranteed ceiling), only platform= narrows the read, the state clears on the first successful read, no operator-side fix today, other DEX routes unaffected.

trigger: open issue #8004 is titled for the exe_key index the measurement does not support
classification_rationale: tracker wording, not code
summary: Orchestrator action, no code: one comment on #8004 with the measured numbers, their scope and the rollup conclusion (no new issue).

trigger: operator reads docs/dex/README.md to learn what the fleet usage route needs
classification_rationale: the README said only per-device usage needs Forensics:Read; the fleet route needs both pairs
summary: Fixed: one sentence corrected in the cited file.

trigger: operator alerting on the dex_usage series for every usage failure
classification_rationale: docs said each failure counts on source dex_usage, but the owner counts only its four faults
summary: Fixed: app-usage.md and rest-api.md say the four owner reasons count on dex_usage and the other causes count on the underlying store's own degrade family.

trigger: caller expects retry_after_ms 2000 on no_population or invalid_request
classification_rationale: the route sends no retry hint for those two reasons while the docs said every failed read carries 2000
summary: Fixed: docs corrected and both reasons added to the 503 enumerations (docs, OpenAPI).

trigger: reader of the usage docs
classification_rationale: documentation wording gaps in files this change already edits
summary: Fixed: the exposure_rate.per_hour interval shape is documented, the service-token reason for the fleet route is corrected in surfaces.md, and the small wording items are folded in.

trigger: reader assumes every request is audited
classification_rationale: a parameter 400 leaves no audit row, yet the docs said every admitted request writes one and surfaces.md said aggregates are not audited
summary: Fixed: every request that passes validation is audited before the read (an unknown-group 400 and a 503 still leave the row), this route is named as the audited aggregate; same wording in the route comment, the OpenAPI description, rest-api.md, audit-log.md, authz-model.md and the SOC 2 row.

trigger: reader takes 'confined by construction' as live per-group confinement
classification_rationale: the Apps rows are the unfiltered fleet list, so only the usage population is filtered, and the filter is inert for every caller admitted today
summary: Fixed: the phrase is replaced by the precise statement (usage figures over the caller's visible devices only; the application list is the fleet list GuaranteedState:Read already serves; filter inert today; with RBAC off only an administrator passes; no live per-group confinement) in the route comment, authz-model.md, the SOC 2 row, app-usage.md, rest-api.md and ADR-1005.

trigger: an MCP twin or dashboard view built from the signal catalog's routed invariants
classification_rationale: the routed-concern long form did not say fleet usage needs both gates and the audit
summary: Fixed in part (adapted): the clause is added to docs/dex-signal-catalog.md 'Routed-concern invariants'. The short phrase in the Guardian/DEX row of .claude/routed-concerns.md is NOT changed by the engineer: that file loads into every session and needs the operator's explicit say-so. Decision for the operator at the push gate: add the phrase to that row or leave it as the pointer it is.

trigger: database-wide stall of two minutes or more
classification_rationale: only a success resets the run, so a long stall can reach fleet_too_large; the text said a burst cannot span two minutes
summary: Fixed: reworded to 'a stall shorter than two minutes stays retryable' in the ADR, the owner header comments and the runbook.

trigger: reader of ADR-0012, the parity ledger prose and the MCP-completeness statements
classification_rationale: stale bookkeeping: with_txn_for in ADR-0012, the 195-196 baseline prose, no paragraph or ADR pointer for the #8096 exception, unqualified MCP statements
summary: Fixed: ADR-0012 names try_acquire_for plus with_txn_on, the ledger prose carries the 197 baseline and a #8096 paragraph (outside the generated block, which is untouched), the ADR-1005 entry points back to it, and surfaces.md and dex.md qualify that fleet usage has no MCP tool yet.

trigger: pool pressure while usage and Apps reads run together
classification_rationale: the runbook did not say usage and Apps reads have separate budgets of 4
summary: Fixed: the runbook names the two budgets (up to 8 leases), yuzu_pg_pool_in_use, yuzu_pg_acquire_wait_seconds and --postgres-pool-size.

trigger: paged operator reads the YuzuGuardianReadDegraded description
classification_rationale: the alert has no link to the fleet_too_large runbook
summary: Fixed (adapted): the shared alert's runbook_url is not repointed; the dex_usage paragraph of the description now carries docs/dex/app-usage.md#runbook-fleet_too_large.

trigger: reader assumes the floor prevents single-device disclosure
classification_rationale: docs never said floor 1 can publish one device's figures or that the audit row names the tag key or group id, not a device
summary: Fixed: stated in app-usage.md, rest-api.md, authz-model.md, the SOC 2 row and the signal catalog clause.

trigger: reader of the Forensics securable rows
classification_rationale: the Forensics rows listed only the per-device application-usage read
summary: Fixed: the fleet usage aggregate (with GuaranteedState:Read) is added to docs/user-manual/rbac.md and docs/authz-model.md.

trigger: delegating the route, a new fleet, a reader of the dex.md bullet
classification_rationale: docs omitted that only Administrator holds both pairs, that a new fleet reads no_usage until the first daily sync, and that the route is REST only
summary: Fixed: (a) delegation needs a custom role with both pairs, (b) no_usage until the first daily sync, (c) the dex.md bullet says REST only, no MCP tool or dashboard yet. ER-4(d) needs nothing: changelog.d/README.md allows the issue number in the fragment name.

trigger: a device that has never reported usage
classification_rationale: the coverage CTE inner-joins usage_state, so a never-reported device is in neither count while the docs said the counts cover the population
summary: Fixed (adapted: doc wording, no SQL or contract change): reporting_devices and stale_devices cover devices that have reported at least once, population minus both is the devices that never have; docs, rest-api.md and the OpenAPI text say so. The CH-1 owner case pins a never-reported device in neither count.

trigger: a server.cpp edit drops a usage wiring assignment
classification_rationale: only dex_usage.read and the pre-seed were pinned
summary: Fixed: pins and self-test mutations for dex_usage.group_members, tag_values and observation_retention_days, and the members-before-existence read order.

trigger: the first-timeout stamp guard removed
classification_rationale: dropping 'only the first timeout stamps the run start' survived the owner tests
summary: Fixed: the existing [pg] 57014 case reads a steady_clock instant after the first real timeout, drives two more real timeouts and asserts fleet_too_large at that instant plus two minutes; with the guard removed the run start moves to the last timeout and the assert fails. No sleep.

trigger: boundary values never exercised
classification_rationale: floor 10000, 256-byte group id and the maximum-length tag_key were untested
summary: Fixed (adapted: extra requests in existing route cases, no new TEST_CASE): floor=10000 accepted and 10001 refused, a 256-byte group id passes validation (unknown-group 400 with its row) and 257 is refused, a 64-byte tag_key accepted.

trigger: reader of the header
classification_rationale: include order differs from docs/cpp-conventions.md (STL, third-party, project)
summary: Fixed: reordered in the cited file.

trigger: client validating the group parameter
classification_rationale: OpenAPI maxLength counts characters, the route counts bytes
summary: Fixed: the group parameter description says at most 256 bytes; the literal-segment gate is re-run.

trigger: an operator reads the 503 message
classification_rationale: the message could read 'group_unavailable: group_unavailable' and the OpenAPI 503 list omitted no_population and invalid_request
summary: Fixed (adapted: the two trivial parts only): the detail is omitted when it equals the reason, and both reasons are in the OpenAPI 503 text. Not restyled to the sibling grammar.

trigger: reader of capability-map section 35.6
classification_rationale: the section said the only read is the per-device route, which this change made false
summary: Fixed (adapted: fold, do not file): one sentence names the fleet aggregate route in the cited file.
